MythicCode.title: MythicCode
MythicCode.description: Represents a unique Mythic Code used for initial access and activation of club membership.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MythicCode entity.

code.description: The actual unique mythic code string provided to users for club access.

status.description: The current status of the mythic code, e.g., 'available' or 'activated'.

activationDateTime.description: Timestamp when the mythic code was activated.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity that activated this code.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores detailed information about a club member, associated with an activated Mythic Code.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

mythicCodeId.description: Reference to the MythicCode entity used by this user.

name.description: The full name of the club member.

email.description: The email address of the club member.

photo.description: Base64 representation of the user's profile photo.

city.description: The city where the user is located.

state.description: The state where the user is located.

emergencyContact.description: Emergency contact phone number for the member.

registrationDateTime.description: Timestamp when the user profile was fully registered.

rankingScore.description: The user's current score or rank within the club.

isPublicProfile.description: Indicates whether the user's profile is visible to other members.

status.description: Elite status: MYTHIC, AMBER or LEGENDARY.

memberNumber.description: The sequential registration number (1-60) based on entry order.

Pet.title: Pet
Pet.description: Records details about a pet owned by a club member.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Pet entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity that owns this pet.

photo.description: Compressed base64 representation of the pet photo.

registrationDateTime.description: Timestamp when the pet was registered.

isEmergencyActive.description: Indicates if the emergency protocol is currently active for this pet.

TransferRequest.title: TransferRequest
TransferRequest.description: Logs a request to transfer membership from one person to another.

/mythicCodes/{mythicCodeId}.description: Unique mythic codes for elite access.

/users/{userId}.description: Member profiles, keyed by Auth UID.
